nodes.text: 7 . 1 Extensions and the registry
nodes.zh: 7.1 扩展与注册表

nodes.text: Your code lives in a registry inside the process; storage only ever records the names of the extensions a conversation wants.
nodes.zh: 你的代码存放在进程内的注册表里；存储层只记录一个会话想要哪些扩展的名字。

nodes.text: An agent needs tools, a system prompt and a few guard rails. You also want to ship a fix to one of them without stopping the agent, and to restart after a crash without losing anything. Pi Durable gets both by keeping all code in memory and storing only names. After this section you can package your code as an extension, install it, replace it, and say what a restart needs.
nodes.zh: 智能体需要工具、系统提示词和几道护栏。你还想在不停止智能体的情况下给其中之一发布修复，并在崩溃后重启而不丢失任何东西。Pi Durable 两样都做到了：所有代码留在内存里，只存名字。读完本节，你就能把代码打包成一个扩展、安装它、替换它，并说明重启需要什么。

nodes.text: The bundle
nodes.zh: 这个包

nodes.text: An extension is a named bundle of your code. It is a plain object with a name and up to five lists. defineExtension() only gives the object its type; it checks nothing src/harness/define.ts. Every list is matched to the rest of the system by a string name, never by object identity. The registry is where extensions meet the Harness. createRegistry() returns an object your application owns. It already holds the three built-in task definitions, pi.generation, pi.tool and pi.compaction, which cannot be removed or replaced. Harness.open() rejects a registry that lacks them, so always start from createRegistry() src/harness/registry.ts; src/harness/harness.ts.
nodes.zh: 扩展是你代码的一个具名包。它是一个普通对象，带一个名字和至多五个列表。`defineExtension()` 只是给这个对象标上类型；它不检查任何东西 `src/harness/define.ts`。每个列表都通过字符串名字与系统其余部分对应，绝不通过对象身份。注册表是扩展与 `Harness` 相遇的地方。`createRegistry()` 返回一个由你的应用拥有的对象。它已经持有三个内置任务定义 `pi.generation`、`pi.tool` 和 `pi.compaction`，它们不能被移除或替换。`Harness.open()` 会拒绝缺少它们的注册表，所以永远从 `createRegistry()` 开始 `src/harness/registry.ts`；`src/harness/harness.ts`。

nodes.text: Names in storage, code in memory
nodes.zh: 存储里是名字，内存里是代码

nodes.text: Nothing in the registry is written to disk. In the spec’s words, the registry “is process-local, may outlive a Harness, and is not persisted” spec §7.1. A conversation records which extensions it wants as a list of names in its pi.agent document (the per- conversation agent (p. 106)). Whenever the Harness needs code, it looks those names up in the registry.
nodes.zh: 注册表里的东西没有任何一样写到磁盘上。用 spec 自己的话，注册表「是进程本地的，可以比 `Harness` 活得更久，并且不被持久化」spec §7.1。会话把想要哪些扩展记成 `pi.agent` 文档里的一份名字列表（按会话的智能体（p. 106））。`Harness` 每次需要代码时，就在注册表里查这些名字。

nodes.text: Code lives in the process registry; a conversation stores only names. Conversation 1 stores no selection and uses the host default. Conversation 7 names three extensions; skills is not installed in this process, so it is skipped and the stored list is left alone. The first three extensions are the listing’s; the reviewer and skills extensions come from spec §7.1.

nodes.text: This split is what makes a restart cheap. The captured database of one answered turn stores the root’s agent as {"model": {"provider": "faux", "modelId": "faux-1"}} and nothing else: no tool or prompt code research/capture/sqlite- rows.txt, document 6. A new process installs its extensions, opens the same storage, and each stored name binds to whatever code now carries it. A name with no installed extension is skipped, not an error, and it “takes effect again when it is installed again” spec §2.2. Task definitions work the same way. A stored task records its kind as a name. If no installed extension defines that name, the task is blocked: it waits, it is not failed. Installing the extension later unblocks it (the scheduler (p. 73)). Install everything before open() anyway, so recovered work resumes at once.
nodes.zh: 这种划分正是让重启变得廉价的原因。抓取到的数据库中，一个已回答轮次把根的智能体存成 `{"model": {"provider": "faux", "modelId": "faux-1"}}`，别的什么都没有：没有工具代码，也没有提示词代码 `research/capture/sqlite-rows.txt`，文档 6。一个新进程安装自己的扩展，打开同一份存储，每个存下的名字就绑定到此刻承载它的代码上。没有已安装扩展的名字会被跳过，不是错误，并且它「在被再次安装时重新生效」spec §2.2。任务定义的机制完全一样。存下的任务把它的 kind 记成一个名字。如果没有任何已安装的扩展定义了这个名字，任务就被阻塞：它在等待，不是失败。之后安装这个扩展会解除阻塞（调度器（p. 73））。不管怎样，都在 `open()` 之前把一切装好，这样恢复的工作能立刻继续。

nodes.text: Install, replace, uninstall
nodes.zh: 安装、替换、卸载

nodes.text: The registry has two operations. install(extension) adds a new name at the end, or replaces the extension that already has that name, in the same position. uninstall(extension) removes whatever holds that name. Each change takes effect immediately, and “an extension is the unit of reload” spec §7.1.
nodes.zh: 注册表有两个操作。`install(extension)` 在末尾添加一个新名字，或者在同一个位置上替换已经占用该名字的扩展。`uninstall(extension)` 移除持有该名字的任何东西。每次改动立刻生效，并且「一个扩展就是重载的单位」spec §7.1。

nodes.text: A same-name install replaces in place; uninstalling and installing again moves the extension to the end. nodes.text: Position is precedence. When two extensions define a tool with the same name, the later one wins, and later hooks run later (hooks (p. 109)). Because a replacement keeps its position, reloading an extension never changes who wins. An install that would leave the registry invalid throws and changes nothing. Tool names and section keys must be unique within one extension; across extensions, a repeated tool name is how one extension overrides another. Section keys are lowercase (^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$) and never instructions, which is reserved. Task names must be unique across the whole registry. Work already running never sees the registry change under it (reload while running (p. 118)).
nodes.zh: 位置就是优先级。两个扩展定义同名工具时，后面的那个胜出，后面的钩子也更晚运行（钩子（p. 109））。因为替换保留了位置，重载一个扩展永远不会改变谁胜出。一个会让注册表变得无效的安装会抛错，什么都不改变。一个扩展内部，工具名和小节键必须唯一；跨扩展时，重复的工具名正是一个扩展覆盖另一个的方式。小节键是小写的（`^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$`），而且绝不是 `instructions`，后者是保留的。任务名必须在整个注册表内唯一。已经在运行的工作绝不会看到脚下的注册表变化（边运行边重载（p. 118））。

nodes.text: Install every extension before Harness.open(), in the order you want precedence. Never rename an extension, tool or task that conversations already use: stored names stop matching. To ship a fix, install the new object under the same name. Install and uninstall call no cleanup code, so free shared resources yourself, and only once old calls finish spec §12.
nodes.zh: 在 `Harness.open()` 之前按你想要的优先级顺序安装每个扩展。绝不要重命名会话已经在用的扩展、工具或任务：存下的名字会失配。要发布修复，就用同一个名字安装新的对象。安装和卸载不调用任何清理代码，所以共享资源要你自己释放，而且要等旧调用结束后只释放一次 spec §12。

7 . 2 The per-conversation agent
nodes.zh: 7.2 按会话的智能体

nodes.text: Each conversation stores its choices as names; the Harness turns them into real tools and prompt sections each time it needs them.
nodes.zh: 每个会话把自己的选择存成名字；`Harness` 每次需要时把它们变成真正的工具和提示词小节。

nodes.text: Different conversations need different setups: the main chat gets every tool, a read-only reviewer gets two, a subagent gets its own instructions. The agent of a conversation is that setup: its model, thinking level, extensions, tools, prompt sections, instructions and working directory. After this section you can configure one and predict exactly which tools the model will be offered.
nodes.zh: 不同会话需要不同配置：主聊天拿到全部工具，一个只读的评审者拿到两个，子智能体拿到它自己的指令。会话的智能体就是这套配置：它的模型、思考级别、扩展、工具、提示词小节、指令和工作目录。读完本节，你就能配置一套智能体，并准确预测模型会被提供哪些工具。

nodes.text: Stored choices, resolved agent
nodes.zh: 存下的选择，解析出的智能体

nodes.text: The agent exists in two forms. The stored form, AgentState, lives in the conversation’s pi.agent document and holds only names. A field you never set follows the host’s defaults. The resolved form, Agent, is what the Harness builds from the stored names, the current registry and the host settings whenever it needs real objects. The stored document forks and rewinds with its conversation (the built-in documents (p. 60)).
nodes.zh: 智能体有两种形态。存下的形态 `AgentState` 活在会话的 `pi.agent` 文档里，只持有名字。你从不设置的字段跟随宿主的默认值。解析出的形态 `Agent` 是 `Harness` 在需要真实对象时，用存下的名字、当前的注册表和宿主设置构建出来的东西。存下的文档随它的会话一起分叉和回溯（内置文档（p. 60））。

nodes.text: Conversation.configure(change, context) edits the stored agent. Each field follows one rule: “a given field replaces the stored one, null clears it, undefined changes nothing” src/harness/agent.ts. You may pass extension and tool objects; they are stored as their names. The standalone configure(tx, id, change) does the same inside a larger commit, an atomic save: everything in it is stored together, or nothing is. Example 7 shows what each call stores.
nodes.zh: `Conversation.configure(change, context)` 编辑存下的智能体。每个字段遵循一条规则：「给出的字段替换存下的字段，`null` 清空它，`undefined` 不做改变」`src/harness/agent.ts`。你可以传扩展对象和工具对象；它们按名字存下。独立的 `configure(tx, id, change)` 在更大的一次提交里做同样的事，也就是一次原子保存：其中的一切要么一起存下，要么都不存。示例 7 展示了每次调用存下什么。

nodes.text: Two failures are quiet on purpose. A wrapper that throws, or that renames its target, removes that tool for this resolution and is reported to HarnessOptions.onReport; a call to it gets a tool_unavailable result. A wrapper whose target is not selected does nothing, so a timing wrapper is safe where there is no bash spec §7.1.
nodes.zh: 两种失败是刻意静默的。一个抛出异常的包装器，或者一个改掉了目标名字的包装器，会在本次解析中移除该工具，并上报到 `HarnessOptions.onReport`；对它的调用会得到一个 `tool_unavailable` 结果。目标未被选中的包装器什么也不做，所以一个计时包装器在没有 `bash` 的地方也是安全的 spec §7.1。

nodes.text: When a change takes effect
nodes.zh: 一个改动何时生效

nodes.text: The Harness resolves the agent again at each decision, never once per run: “each reader resolves once per decision” spec §7.1. Host settings work the same way. HarnessOptions.settings holds Harness-wide policy (the default selection, retry, compaction, tool execution mode, queue modes). It is never copied or stored, so a settings object with getters “follows the user’s preferences without a Session write” spec §2.2. The defaults are in settings and defaults (p. 180).
nodes.zh: `Harness` 在每个决策点重新解析智能体，绝不是每次运行只解析一次：「每个读取者在每个决策点解析一次」spec §7.1。宿主设置同理。`HarnessOptions.settings` 保存 `Harness` 全局的策略（默认选择、重试、压缩、工具执行模式、队列模式）。它从不被复制或存储，所以一个带 getter 的设置对象会「跟随用户偏好而无需一次 `Session` 写入」spec §2.2。默认值见「设置与默认值」（p. 180）。

nodes.text: So a change made during a turn reaches the next model request. A call the model already made resolves its tool when it runs. If you removed that tool in between, the call gets tool_unavailable; if you changed cwd, the call sees the new directory README §Per-Conversation Agent.
nodes.zh: 所以一轮次期间做出的改动会到达下一次模型请求。模型已经发出的调用在它运行时解析自己的工具。如果你在中间移除了那个工具，这个调用会得到 `tool_unavailable`；如果你改了 `cwd`，这个调用会看到新目录 `README` §Per-Conversation Agent。

nodes.text: Copies at creation
nodes.zh: 创建时的副本

nodes.text: A new conversation starts with a copy of someone’s agent, or with nothing src/harness/agent.ts createAgent(): Fork — the parent’s agent as it was at the fork point (forks (p. 43)). Task-owned — a copy of every stored field of the owning task’s conversation, instructions included. Later changes to the owner do not reach it. Ownerless — empty, {}: every field follows the host. The agent option of root(), createConversation() and fork() then applies its change in the same commit.
nodes.zh: 一个新会话要么从某人的智能体副本开始，要么从空白开始 `src/harness/agent.ts` `createAgent()`：Fork——父方在分叉那一刻的智能体（分叉（p. 43））。Task-owned——所属任务的会话每一个存下字段的副本，包括 `instructions`。之后对拥有者的改动不会传给它。Ownerless——空白，即 `{}`：每个字段都跟随宿主。`root()`、`createConversation()` 和 `fork()` 的 `agent` 选项随后在同一次提交里应用它的改动。

nodes.text: { add, remove } “always edits the host default selection”, never a copied list. A child that copied the list ["a", "b"] and then receives { remove: [b] } ends up with the host default minus b, not ["a"]. To edit a copied list, read the resolved agent’s extensions and write the new list spec §2.2, §12.

nodes.text: 7 . 3 Hooks
nodes.zh: 7.3 钩子

nodes.text: A hook is a question a built-in task asks your extensions just before it commits a decision; your answer shapes what gets written.
nodes.zh: 钩子是内置任务在提交某个决策之前向你的扩展提出的一个问题；你的回答决定写入什么。

nodes.text: You often want to steer the agent without rewriting it: block a dangerous shell command, trim old messages before a request, or ask the model to keep going when its answer is weak. Hooks do this. After this section you can write each hook, predict how several extensions’ answers combine, and keep a human approval stable across a crash.
nodes.zh: 你常常想引导智能体而不重写它：拦住一条危险的 shell 命令，在一次请求前裁掉旧消息，或者在答案薄弱时请模型继续。钩子做这些事。读完本节，你就能写出每一种钩子，预测多个扩展的回答如何合并，并让一次人工审批在崩溃中保持稳定。

nodes.text: Who gets asked
nodes.zh: 谁会被问到

nodes.text: An extension registers handlers with hook(task, handlers), for example hook(ToolTask, { beforeTool }). The task object gives type checking; only its name is kept, so “hooks survive a reload of their task” spec §7.2. A task asks only the hooks of extensions that its conversation selects. That is the whole scoping model: “To limit a hook to some conversations, select its extension only there” README §Hooks. There is no global hook. The flip side matters for safety: a conversation whose extension list leaves out your permissions extension runs without its guard spec §12.
nodes.zh: 扩展用 `hook(task, handlers)` 注册处理器，例如 `hook(ToolTask, { beforeTool })`。任务对象提供类型检查；只有它的名字被保留，所以「钩子在其任务被重载后依然存在」spec §7.2。一个任务只问它的会话所选中的那些扩展的钩子。这就是全部的作用域模型：「要把一个钩子限制到某些会话，就只在那些会话里选中它的扩展」`README` §Hooks。没有全局钩子。这一面对安全性很重要：一个扩展列表里没有你的权限扩展的会话，会在没有它那道守卫的情况下运行 spec §12。

nodes.text: The seven hooks
nodes.zh: 七种钩子

nodes.text: The generation task asks four hooks, the tool task two and the compaction task one. When several extensions answer, each hook combines the answers in its own way.
nodes.zh: 生成任务问四种钩子，工具任务问两种，压缩任务问一种。多个扩展都回答时，每种钩子用自己的方式合并这些回答。

nodes.text: Make decisions crash-safe with memos
nodes.zh: 用 memo 让决策崩溃安全

nodes.text: A hook can run twice: “a crash before the consuming commit may rerun them” spec §7.2. That is harmless for a pure check, but a human approval must not be asked again or change. Store it with api.memo(name, …), which keeps the first value written: a rerun that tries to record "denied" gets "approved" back test/harness-tools.test.ts. Hooks share the asking task’s memo names, so prefix yours (phases, steps and progress (p. 67)). To show status in a UI, commit it to a document (the conversation view (p. 129)).
nodes.zh: 一个钩子可能运行两次：「消费它的那次提交之前的崩溃可能让它们重跑」spec §7.2。对纯检查来说这无害，但一次人工审批不能被再问一遍，也不能改变。用 `api.memo(name, …)` 存下它，它保留第一次写入的值：一次试图记下 `"denied"` 的重跑拿回的是 `"approved"` `test/harness-tools.test.ts`。钩子与提问的任务共用 memo 名字，所以要给自己的加前缀（阶段、步骤与进展（p. 67））。要在界面里显示状态，就把它提交到一个文档（会话视图（p. 129））。

nodes.text: Keep state in documents
nodes.zh: 把状态放在文档里

nodes.text: Selecting an extension decides whether a conversation has a behavior. A document holds that behavior’s state. Plan mode in spec §7.2 is the pattern: the extension is selected everywhere, and its beforeTool reads the conversation’s own plan-mode document.
nodes.zh: 选中一个扩展决定了一个会话是否拥有某种行为。文档持有这个行为的状态。spec §7.2 里的计划模式就是这个模式：扩展在各处都被选中，而它的 `beforeTool` 读取会话自己的计划模式文档。

nodes.text: Extensions get no setup step when a conversation is created, so a hook treats a missing document as “off”. Example 27 builds the other variant, a mode switched by changing the selection (building a coding agent (p. 159)).
nodes.zh: 会话创建时扩展不会得到任何安装步骤，所以一个钩子把缺失的文档当作「关」。示例 27 构建了另一个变体：一种通过改变选择来切换的模式（构建一个编码智能体（p. 159））。

nodes.text: Details Arguments are checked twice — against the tool’s schema before beforeTool and after it. A rewrite that breaks the schema gives invalid_arguments; a block gives blocked. beforeTool is not rerun after intent — once the call’s intent is committed, recovery reuses the stored arguments (tool calls and replay (p. 94)). Hook work holds the task — a task a hook creates is owned by the asking task and keeps it open until it ends spec §12.
nodes.zh: 详解 参数被检查两次——在 `beforeTool` 之前按工具的 schema 检查一次，之后再检查一次。破坏 schema 的改写给出 `invalid_arguments`；一次拦截给出 `blocked`。意图之后不会重跑 `beforeTool`——一旦这次调用的意图被提交，恢复会复用存下的参数（工具调用与重放（p. 94））。钩子工作会占住这个任务——钩子创建的任务归提问的任务所有，并让它保持开启直到结束 spec §12。

nodes.text: Put guards in beforeTool; a throw blocks, which is the safe default. Select a guard’s extension in every conversation that needs it, including subagents that use a stored extension list. Store any decision a human made in a memo, and any mode in a document.
nodes.zh: 把守卫放在 `beforeTool` 里；抛出异常就拦截，这是安全的默认值。在每个需要它的会话里都选中守卫所在的扩展，包括使用存下扩展列表的子智能体。凡是人做出的决定都存进 memo，任何模式都存进文档。

7 . 4 Defining tools
nodes.zh: 7.4 定义工具

nodes.text: A tool is a schema, a replay policy and an execute() function; the Harness turns what it reports into exactly one result entry.
nodes.zh: 工具是一个 schema、一条重放策略和一个 `execute()` 函数；`Harness` 把它报告的内容变成恰好一个结果条目。

nodes.text: A tool is how the model acts on the world: reading a file, running a command, calling an API. The hard part is a crash halfway through. After this section you can define a typed tool, stream its output to a UI, choose its replay policy, and read the result entry it leaves behind.
nodes.zh: 工具是模型作用于世界的方式：读一个文件、跑一条命令、调一个 API。难的是执行到一半崩溃。读完本节，你就能定义一个带类型的工具，把它的输出流给界面，选择它的重放策略，并读出它留下的结果条目。

nodes.text: Choose a replay policy

nodes.text: Every tool author must answer one question: if the process dies while my tool runs, may it run again? Before running a call, the tool task writes the final arguments and the policy to disk. On restart it reruns the call only if both the stored and the current tool say "safe". Otherwise it writes an interrupted error result with whatever output was saved. Declare safe only when running twice with the same arguments is harmless. The full story, with a captured crash, is in tool calls and replay (p. 94).
nodes.zh: 每个工具作者都必须回答一个问题：如果进程在我的工具运行时死了，它可以再跑一次吗？在运行一次调用之前，工具任务把最终参数和策略写到磁盘上。重启时，只有存下的工具和当前的工具都说是 `"safe"`，它才重跑这次调用。否则它写下一个 `interrupted` 错误结果，带着当时保存下来的输出。只有以同样的参数跑两次无害时才声明 `safe`。完整的故事，连同一次抓取到的崩溃，见「工具调用与重放」（p. 94）。

nodes.text: From result to entry
nodes.zh: 从结果到条目

nodes.text: Every field of the returned result is optional: content, isError, details, diagnostics, usage and control. The tool task fills the gaps, runs the afterTool hooks, bounds long text (adding a truncated warning), and writes one entry. When there are diagnostics, the text the model sees ends with a <harness> block, one line per diagnostic, and the entry’s data keeps them as a list.
nodes.zh: 返回结果的每个字段都是可选的：`content`、`isError`、`details`、`diagnostics`、`usage` 和 `control`。工具任务补齐空缺，运行 `afterTool` 钩子，给长文本设上限（加上一条被截断的警告），然后写一个条目。存在诊断时，模型看到的文本以一个 `<harness>` 块结尾，每条诊断一行，而条目的 `data` 把它们保留为一个列表。

lines: A tool-result entry stores exactly what the model saw, plus the structured diagnostics. Entry 13 of research/capture/sqlite-rows.txt, the count tool’s answer to count {"n": 3}, keys in captured order.

nodes.text: Errors come in two kinds, and the difference matters. A result with isError: true is an ordinary answer: the task completes. A throw from execute() also becomes an error result, with code tool_error and the partial output kept, but it ends the tool task failed, which aborts anything the call started src/harness/tool.ts. Errors the Harness writes itself carry a code that says why: tool_unavailable, invalid_arguments, blocked, interrupted or aborted. Two result fields act on the turn. usage records the tool’s own spend (usage and cost (p. 100)). control can offer more tools (addTools), end the run when every result of the round asks (terminate), or hand off to a fresh context (handoff, reset, handoff and heads (p. 46)).
nodes.zh: 错误有两种，区别很重要。带 `isError: true` 的结果是一个普通回答：任务完成。从 `execute()` 抛出的异常也会变成一个错误结果，`code` 为 `tool_error`，部分输出被保留，但它会让工具任务以失败结束，这会中止这次调用启动的任何东西 `src/harness/tool.ts`。`Harness` 自己写下的错误带一个说明原因的 `code`：`tool_unavailable`、`invalid_arguments`、`blocked`、`interrupted` 或 `aborted`。两个结果字段作用于整个轮次。`usage` 记录工具自己的开销（用量与成本（p. 100））。`control` 可以提供更多工具（`addTools`）、在这一轮每个结果都要求时结束运行（`terminate`），或交给一个全新的上下文（交接、重置、交接与头指针（p. 46））。

nodes.text: What execute() receives
nodes.zh: `execute()` 收到什么

nodes.text: execute(args, api, context) gets an api object made for this one call. Every operation on it fails once the call has ended. The parts you will use most: env — files and processes for the conversation’s current cwd, or undefined when the host configured none (the execution environment (p. 155)). output(chunk) — append running text, like stdout. If the result has no content, the kept text becomes the content. details(value, context) — publish structured progress for a UI; the last value becomes the result’s details if the result has none. diagnostic(d) — attach a remark for the model, such as a warning, separate from the tool’s data. commit, memo, createTask — commits, memos and child tasks, as in any task. conversation(id) — a handle to a conversation this call created (subagents (p. 121)). Output, details and diagnostics reach the UI while the tool runs, about every 100 ms through the live document. The model sees none of it until the result entry is written (run control and the live document (p. 88)).
nodes.zh: `execute(args, api, context)` 拿到一个为这一次调用准备的 `api` 对象。它上面的每个操作在调用结束后都会失败。你最常用的部分：`env`——会话当前 `cwd` 的文件与进程，宿主没有配置时为 `undefined`（执行环境（p. 155））。`output(chunk)`——追加运行中的文本，比如 stdout。如果结果没有 `content`，保留下来的文本就成为 `content`。`details(value, context)`——为界面发布结构化进展；如果结果没有 `details`，最后一个值成为结果的 `details`。`diagnostic(d)`——给模型附上一条说明，比如一条警告，与工具的数据分开。`commit`、`memo`、`createTask`——提交、memo 和子任务，与任何任务里一样。`conversation(id)`——指向这次调用创建的某个会话的句柄（子智能体（p. 121））。`output`、`details` 和诊断在工具运行时就到达界面，大约每 100 ms 一次，通过实时文档。模型在结果条目被写出之前看不到其中任何东西（运行控制与实时文档（p. 88））。

nodes.text: Built-in tools and wrappers
nodes.zh: 内置工具与包装器

nodes.text: @earendil-works/pi-durable/tools ships read, write, edit and bash, together as the CodingTools extension (coding- tools). Nothing installs them for you. They work only through api.env, and all four are replay-unsafe. bash keeps the tail of long output, points to a file with the full output, and fails on a nonzero exit or a timeout src/tools/. To change a tool for some conversations, override or wrap it rather than copy it. A later extension’s tool with the same name replaces the earlier one, and wrapTool(tool, wrapper) decorates whichever tool won. A wrapper “never captures a base, so reloading the base keeps its wrappers” spec §7.3. Example 30 gives one conversation a bash that activates a virtualenv and times every bash call in both run 30.
nodes.zh: `@earendil-works/pi-durable/tools` 提供了 `read`、`write`、`edit` 和 `bash`，合起来就是 `CodingTools` 扩展（`coding-tools`）。没有东西会替你安装它们。它们只能通过 `api.env` 工作，而且这四个都是重载不安全的。`bash` 保留长输出的尾部，指向一个包含完整输出的文件，并在非零退出或超时时失败 `src/tools/`。要为某些会话改变一个工具，就覆盖或包装它，而不是复制它。同名的后一个扩展的工具会替换前一个，而 `wrapTool(tool, wrapper)` 装饰那个胜出的工具。包装器「从不捕获一个 base，所以重载 base 会保留它的包装器」spec §7.3。示例 30 让一个会话拥有一个会激活 virtualenv 并为每次 `bash` 调用计时的 `bash`，见运行 30。

nodes.text: Leave replay unsafe unless a rerun is harmless; record anything random in a memo first. Return isError: true for expected failures; throw only when the call’s own work should be aborted. Use diagnostic() for remarks to the model, not the tool’s output.
nodes.zh: 除非重跑无害，否则保持重载不安全；任何随机的值先用 memo 记下。预期内的失败返回 `isError: true`；只有当这次调用自身的工作应该被中止时才抛异常。给模型的说明用 `diagnostic()`，不要用工具的输出。

nodes.text: 7 . 5 The system prompt
nodes.zh: 7.5 系统提示词

nodes.text: Nothing stores the prompt; each request renders it from sections, and only what changed is added to the transcript.
nodes.zh: 没有什么存下提示词；每次请求都从小节渲染它，而只有变化的部分被加进记录。

nodes.text: Providers cache the start of a prompt, so rewriting the system prompt on every turn wastes money and time. Pi Durable builds the prompt from small named pieces and, when one piece changes, sends only that piece. After this section you can write prompt sections and keep a conversation’s prompt cache warm.
nodes.zh: 供应商会缓存提示词的开头，所以每个轮次都重写系统提示词就是浪费钱和时间。Pi Durable 用小的具名片段构建提示词，某个片段变化时只发送那个片段。读完本节，你就能编写提示词小节，并让一个会话的提示词缓存保持温热。

nodes.text: Sections
nodes.zh: 小节

nodes.text: A section is a named piece of the system prompt. section(key, render) builds one. render returns a string, or undefined to leave the section out. By default the text is wrapped in tags, <key>…</key>; { tag: false } sends it as is. The selected extensions’ sections and the agent’s instructions are the only source of prompt text spec §7.4. A render function gets the resolved agent (including the tools this request offers), the env for this request (a cwd section renders input.env?.cwd), and read for committed document reads. Sections come in extension order, a later same-key section replaces an earlier one in place, wrapSection() decorators apply, and instructions come last. Example 15 shows all of this on two conversations.

7 . 6 Reload while running
nodes.zh: 7.6 边运行边重载

nodes.text: Installing a new version under the same name swaps the code for all future work at once; work already running finishes on the code it started with.
nodes.zh: 用同一个名字安装一个新版本，会一次性把所有未来工作的代码换掉；已经在运行的工作用它启动时的代码跑完。

nodes.text: You fix a bug in a tool while an agent is mid-turn. You want the fix live now, without killing the turn, and without a half- old, half-new tool call. After this section you can reload an extension in a running Harness, say which work sees the old or new code, and avoid the two reload bugs the registry cannot catch.
nodes.zh: 你在一个智能体处于轮次中间时修工具里的一个 bug。你想让修复立刻生效，不干掉这个轮次，也不出现一次半旧半新的工具调用。读完本节，你就能在运行中的 `Harness` 里重载一个扩展，说清哪些工作看到旧代码、哪些看到新代码，并避开注册表抓不到的两个重载 bug。

nodes.text: Reload is an install
nodes.zh: 重载就是一次安装

nodes.text: There is no reload API. You install the new extension object under the same name. It replaces the old one in place, and “the Harness keeps running; no close or reopen is required” spec §7.5. Because the position is kept, the extension’s tools, hooks and sections keep their precedence. Example 31 reloads a tool while a call to it is running, then restarts the process.
nodes.zh: 没有重载 API。你用同一个名字安装新的扩展对象。它就地替换旧的，而且「`Harness` 继续运行；不需要关闭或重新打开」spec §7.5。因为位置被保留，这个扩展的工具、钩子和小节保住它们的优先级。示例 31 在一次对它的调用正在运行时重载一个工具，然后重启进程。

Who sees which code
nodes.zh: 谁看到哪份代码

nodes.text: Three rules decide it: A phase keeps its code — each task phase (one handler run between checkpoints) works from a registry snapshot taken when it starts. Its hooks and agent stay fixed until it ends src/harness/scheduler.ts. The next phase sees the new code — each new phase takes a fresh snapshot. One run may use different versions across its phases: “nothing requires one run to see a single registry state” spec §7.1. A tool call is pinned until it finishes — the call finds its tool, runs its hooks, executes and writes its result in one phase, “so nothing separates resolution from settlement” src/harness/tool.ts.
nodes.zh: 三条规则决定它：一个阶段保住自己的代码——任务的每个阶段（两个检查点之间的一次处理器运行）都从它开始时取的注册表快照出发。它的钩子和智能体固定不变直到结束 `src/harness/scheduler.ts`。下一个阶段看到新代码——每个新阶段取一份新快照。同一次运行的不同阶段可能用不同版本：「没有什么要求一次运行只能看到一个注册表状态」spec §7.1。一次工具调用被钉住直到完成——这次调用在同一个阶段里找到它的工具、运行它的钩子、执行并写出结果，「所以不会有什么把解析和落定分开」`src/harness/tool.ts`。

nodes.text: The tests pin both halves. A tool replaced mid-call still returns “v1”. A section and a beforeRequest hook reloaded while a tool runs show mode: v1 in the first request and mode: v2 in the second test/harness-tools.test.ts. Replacing code “never signals or interrupts” running work spec §7.5.
nodes.zh: 两个方向都有测试钉住。调用中途被替换的工具仍然返回「v1」。一个 `section` 和一个 `beforeRequest` 钩子在工具运行期间被重载，第一次请求显示 `mode: v1`，第二次显示 `mode: v2` `test/harness-tools.test.ts`。替换代码「从不发出信号或中断」运行中的工作 spec §7.5。

nodes.text: Task definitions hand over
nodes.zh: 任务定义会交接

nodes.text: Your own task definitions reload by name too. When a running task finishes a phase and a different definition is now installed for its kind, the task is handed to the new code if it can take it: the same version, or a newer one with a migrate function. Otherwise the old code keeps running it and the mismatch is reported. Versioning and migration are in the scheduler (p. 73). Installing also unblocks. A task left blocked because its extension was missing at open, or because its stored version was too new, runs as soon as a fitting definition is installed. harness.inspect() shows which tasks are blocked (the task graph and inspect() (p. 137)).
nodes.zh: 你自己的任务定义同样按名字重载。当一个运行中的任务结束一个阶段，而它的 kind 此刻装上了一个不同的定义时，只要新代码能接手，任务就交给它：同一个版本，或者一个带 `migrate` 函数的更新版本。否则旧代码继续运行它，并上报这个不匹配。版本与迁移见「调度器」（p. 73）。安装还会解除阻塞。一个因为扩展在 `open` 时缺失、或因为存下的版本太新而阻塞的任务，一旦装上一个合适的定义就跑起来。`harness.inspect()` 显示哪些任务被阻塞（任务图与 `inspect()`（p. 137））。

nodes.text: What a reload does not touch
nodes.zh: 重载不触及的东西

nodes.text: Nothing on disk changes. A reload commits nothing, emits no event and rewrites no transcript. A conversation that uses the extension gets a system delta at its next request, but only if the rendered sections or tool declarations differ (the system prompt (p. 115)). A restart is a reload from an empty registry. After the second process opens the file, the root’s agent has no tools until the extension is installed again, then it has the new code’s version tool run 31. Pending tasks from the extension resume once it is installed. Never open the new Harness before the old one’s close() has resolved: two instances must not own one Session at once.
nodes.zh: 磁盘上什么都没有变化。重载不提交任何东西，不发出任何事件，也不重写任何记录。一个使用该扩展的会话在下一次请求时会收到一个系统增量，但仅限于渲染出的小节或工具声明确实不同（系统提示词（p. 115））。重启就是从空注册表开始的一次重载。第二个进程打开文件之后，根的智能体没有任何工具，直到扩展被再次装上，然后它有了新代码的那个版本工具 运行 31。来自这个扩展的待处理任务在装上之后恢复。绝不要在旧的 `close()` 兑现之前打开新的 `Harness`：两个实例不能同时拥有一个 `Session`。

nodes.text: Early cleanup: replacing an extension “only stops new use”. Closing a database pool or a child process right after install() breaks calls still running on the old object. Moving tasks: moving a task definition from one extension to another “leaves a gap between the two installs in which its pending tasks are blocked” spec §7.5, §12.
nodes.zh: 过早清理：替换一个扩展「只会停止新的使用」。紧跟在 `install()` 之后关闭数据库连接池或子进程，会破坏仍在旧对象上运行的调用。移动任务：把一个任务定义从一个扩展移到另一个扩展，「会在两次安装之间留下一段空档，其待处理任务被阻塞」spec §7.5、§12。

nodes.text: Reload by installing under the same name; there is nothing else to call. Bump a task’s version when the meaning of its stored input or checkpoints changes. If old code ignores cancellation and never finishes, close() still waits for it. Only running extensions in a separate worker or process lets you kill them spec §7.5, §13.
nodes.zh: 用同一个名字安装来重载；没有别的可调。当一个任务存下的输入或检查点的含义变化时，提升它的版本。如果旧代码忽略取消且永远不结束，`close()` 仍然会等它。只有把扩展跑在一个独立的 worker 或进程里，你才能杀掉它们 spec §7.5、§13。

nodes.text: 7 . 7 Subagents
nodes.zh: 7.7 子智能体

nodes.text: A subagent is an ordinary conversation owned by the work that created it; ownership and request IDs make it abortable and crash-safe without a
nodes.zh: 子智能体是一个普通会话，由创建它的工作所拥有；所有权和请求 ID 让它可中止、崩溃安全，而不需要一套

nodes.text: subagent API.
nodes.zh: 子智能体 API。

nodes.text: A subagent is a second agent, with its own transcript, that your agent hands a job to: “research this”, “review that diff”. You build one from conversations, ownership and a tool. After this section you can write the two patterns the package ships, and predict what an abort, an idle wait and a crash do to each.
nodes.zh: 子智能体是第二个智能体，有自己的记录，你把一件活交给它：「研究这个」「评审那个 diff」。你用会话、所有权和一个工具来构建它。读完本节，你就能写出这个包提供的两种模式，并预测中止、空闲等待和崩溃各自会对它们做什么。

nodes.text: The foreground pattern
nodes.zh: 前台模式

nodes.text: A foreground subagent lives inside one tool call. The tool creates a child conversation owned by its own tool task, sends it the job, waits for the answer and returns it. Each durable action is keyed, so a rerun after a crash finds what the first attempt made.
nodes.zh: 一个前台子智能体活在一次工具调用内部。这个工具创建一个由它自己的工具任务拥有的子会话，把活交给它，等待答案并返回。每个持久动作都有键，所以崩溃后的重跑能找到第一次尝试做出来的东西。

nodes.text: Ownership decides abort and idle
nodes.zh: 所有权决定中止与空闲

nodes.text: Owning the child makes it part of the call’s work. “Aborting the call aborts the child”, and so does the call failing; “the parent is idle only once the child is” README §Abort and Subagents. A tool task that owns running work stays open until that work ends (ownership and structured concurrency (p. 76), abort, fault and orphan (p. 80)).
nodes.zh: 拥有子会话让它成为这次调用工作的一部分。「中止这次调用就会中止子会话」，这次调用失败也一样；「父方只有在子会话之后才空闲」`README` §Abort and Subagents。一个拥有运行中工作的工具任务会保持开启直到那份工作结束（所有权与结构化并发（p. 76），中止、故障与孤儿（p. 80））。

Right: ex 23, where the anchor completes at once and a reporter task delivers each message to the child and posts the answer back to the parent. The dashed line is the background boundary: the parent’s Esc and idle waits stop there.
The background pattern
nodes.zh: 后台模式

nodes.text: A background subagent outlives the parent’s turns: the user can message it, stop it and list it later. Example 23 puts this behind one subagent tool with the actions spawn, send, stop and status. A spawn commits three things at once. An anchor task, app.subagent-anchor, is a background task of the parent conversation; it completes at once and stays open while the child works. The child conversation is owned by the anchor, without the subagent extension and with its own instructions. The parent’s app.subagents document maps the subagent’s name to the child; a fork of the parent starts with it empty.
nodes.zh: 一个后台子智能体活得比父方的轮次更久：用户可以给它发消息、停掉它，以后再列出它。示例 23 把这放在一个带 `spawn`、`send`、`stop` 和 `status` 四个动作的 `subagent` 工具后面。一次 `spawn` 一次提交三样东西。一个锚点任务 `app.subagent-anchor` 是父会话的后台任务；它立刻完成，并在子会话工作期间保持开启。子会话由这个锚点拥有，不带 `subagent` 扩展，并有自己的 `instructions`。父方的 `app.subagents` 文档把子智能体的名字映射到子会话；父方的一个分叉开始时它是空的。

nodes.text: Each message travels through a background reporter task, app.subagent-reporter. It submits the message to the child, waits, and posts the answer to the parent as a follow-up input. Both submissions use request IDs derived from the reporter’s ID, “so the child gets the message once and the parent gets the answer once” spec §7.3. Run 23 closes the Harness while the subagent works; after the restart the parent still receives reader: Moby Dick.
nodes.zh: 每条消息都经过一个后台 reporter 任务 `app.subagent-reporter`。它把消息提交给子会话，等待，再把答案作为一条后续输入发给父方。两次提交都用从 reporter 的 ID 派生出的请求 ID，「所以子会话只收到一次消息，父方只收到一次答案」spec §7.3。运行 23 在子智能体工作期间关闭 `Harness`；重启之后父方仍然收到 `reader: Moby Dick`。

nodes.text: The background flag is a wall. The parent’s Esc and idle waits stop at the anchor, so they leave subagents alone. abort(context, { background: true }) still reaches through. The stop action aborts the child directly: its current answer ends, queued messages are dropped, and the subagent stays usable, as any finished subagent does spec §5.4.
nodes.zh: background 标志是一堵墙。父方的 Esc 和空闲等待止步于锚点，所以它们不会去动子智能体。`abort(context, { background: true })` 仍然能穿透过去。`stop` 动作直接中止子会话：它当前的答案结束，排队的消息被丢弃，而子智能体保持可用，就像任何已完成的子智能体一样 spec §5.4。

nodes.text: Key every durable action: find the child by owner, and derive request IDs from a task ID. Pick foreground for a job inside one answer, background for an agent the user talks to later. Never report the child’s spend as the tool’s usage; it would count twice (usage and cost (p. 100)).
nodes.zh: 为每个持久动作加上键：按所有者找子会话，并从任务 ID 派生请求 ID。一个答案内部的活选前台，用户之后还会对话的智能体选后台。绝不要把子会话的开销报成工具的 `usage`；那会被计两次（用量与成本（p. 100））。
